R421.note: encode_entities() applied to both interpolated fields before HTML assembly; closes the reflected XSS cleanly.

R422.note: JNDI parameterized filter (filterExpr/filterArgs) auto-escapes per RFC 4515; substituting a default SearchControls for the original null is disclosed and reasonable.

R423.note: jwt.verify with explicit algorithms allowlist closes the forged-signature bypass; downstream role check is preserved unchanged.

R424.note: drops the attacker-controlled envp array (the reported sink) and offers a disclosed allowlist alternative; the unrelated exec'd command doesn't consume that env var so output is unaffected.

R425.note: switching to a non-DTD-capable parser correctly closes XXE, but fast-xml-parser's default numeric tag coercion (and processEntities:false disabling standard entity decoding like &) can silently change the returned orderId's type/content; not disclosed.

R426.note: allowlist gate before require() closes the injection; the specific plugin names are invented since no plugins/ directory exists in the case to verify against, but this is disclosed as an allowlist requiring adaptation.

R427.note: Path.resolve(strict=True) plus is_relative_to() correctly resolves symlinks before the containment check, closing the reported bypass.

R428.note: ProcessBuilder with an argument array closes shell metacharacter injection, but hardcoding "echo" as argv[0] (dropping the original cmd.exe/sh branching) breaks on Windows since echo is a shell builtin, not a standalone executable on PATH; not disclosed.

R429.note: ObjectInputFilter allowlist correctly implements JEP 290 semantics (UNDECIDED for null, REJECTED default); container-type additions are flagged as adjustable.

R430.note: AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding with a fresh random IV correctly replaces ECB; IV-prepend format change is explained, GCM alternative offered.

R431.note: single-pass character escaping (no chained String.replace order bug) correctly neutralizes LDAP metacharacters before concatenation.

R432.note: ownership check has the right shape but calls getProjectOwner(), which is never defined anywhere in the 3-file case; as given, every call (including the legitimate owner's) throws a ReferenceError, undisclosed.

R433.note: column/direction allowlist plus orderBy() correctly replaces raw SQL injection surface while preserving normal sort behavior.

R434.note: RFC 4515 escaping with backslash escaped first is correctly ordered; added empty/whitespace check is disclosed and only affects an edge case.

R435.note: PreparedStatement with setString() correctly parameterizes the query, but the write-up only notes (without applying) that the finally block must close the new PreparedStatement instead of the old Statement, leaving a resource leak if patched literally.

R436.note: same correct single-pass RFC 4515 escaping pattern as R431/R434, no ordering bug, closes the injection.

R437.note: Math.multiplyExact converts the silent overflow into a catchable ArithmeticException; legitimate small counts are unaffected.

R438.note: mixes named @accountId/@status placeholders with ExecuteSqlRawAsync's object[] overload, which requires {0}/{1}-style positional placeholders (or actual DbParameter objects) -- as written this throws a parameter-binding SQL error on every call, breaking the endpoint entirely; undisclosed.

R439.note: adds secure=True to the cookie; minimal, correct, no other behavior change.

R440.note: column allowlist for the ORDER BY identifier matches exactly the columns exposed in the SELECT list, so the restriction doesn't remove any working functionality; disclosed rejection path.

R441.note: ProcessBuilder array closes the vector on the Unix branch, but the Windows branch still runs cmd.exe /c dir <data>, and cmd.exe re-parses its own shell metacharacters (&, |, etc.) across the joined command line regardless of argv separation, leaving CWE-78 live on Windows.

R442.note: StackExchange.Redis StringSet uses RESP length-prefixed framing, correctly closing CRLF command injection; DI/wiring change is disclosed.

R443.note: Path.resolve() plus is_relative_to() correctly implements containment; added 400/404 handling is a disclosed, reasonable improvement over unhandled exceptions.

R444.note: AesGcm with a fresh per-message nonce and tag correctly replaces ECB with AEAD; key-size change and placeholder key are explicitly flagged.

R445.note: GetFullPath + GetRelativePath containment check correctly rejects traversal and rooted paths without altering behavior for legitimate filenames.

R446.note: removes the CSRF exemption for the billing path, restoring Spring Security's default protection -- the resulting requirement for clients to supply a CSRF token is the fix itself, not an incidental side effect.

R447.note: moves the state-changing handler onto the CSRF-protected mux; minimal one-line fix that matches the reported gap exactly.

R448.note: strips CR/LF/tab only for the log line, leaving the raw username used for the actual auth lookup untouched.

R449.note: allowlist dispatch maps only to the two functions actually defined in the file, correctly eliminating arbitrary dispatch.

R450.note: binds the verification key to RS256 while sourcing it from an env var named JWT_SECRET_KEY (implying a symmetric HMAC secret); RS256 requires a PEM-formatted public key, so as written every legitimate token would fail signature verification, silently breaking authentication for all users.

R451.note: crypto.randomBytes(32) hex is a drop-in replacement for the token; no other code assumes a particular length or charset.

R452.note: SecureRandom + URL-safe base64 produces an opaque cookie value compared only by equality; no downstream format assumption broken.

R453.note: OWASP Encoder Encode.forHtml() applied at both interpolation points into the HTML body, closing the injection at the sink.

R454.note: hand-rolled RESP bulk-string framing (length-prefixed arguments) correctly defeats CRLF-based command injection while producing an equivalent Redis command.

R455.note: content-sniffed MIME allowlist plus server-generated random filename is the standard, sound fix for unrestricted upload; disclosed filename behavior change.

R456.note: shared_ptr keeps the Session alive for as long as the queued lambda holds it, correctly eliminating the dangling-pointer callback; destruction timing is unchanged from the original.

R457.note: HttpUtility.HtmlEncode() applied directly at the Response.Write sink, standard and correct.

R458.note: removing Html.Raw only prevents the described breakout because <script> raw-text content isn't HTML-entity-decoded by the browser -- an HTML encoder is the wrong tool for a JS-string sink, and any legitimate label containing &, ', ", <, or > (e.g. "O'Brien's dashboard") will now render as literal escaped entities instead of the real characters, an undisclosed display regression.

R459.note: RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(16) hex-encoded meets the 128-bit floor and is a drop-in replacement for the dictionary-keyed token.

R460.note: switches the reader to json.loads(), but the nightly batch job that populates the cache (explicitly out of scope) still writes pickle, and the reconstruct_model() the fix calls is never defined -- both gaps are at least flagged as required follow-up rather than left silent.
